title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
full_description:
The expected salary for this position:13 000 - 25 000 PLN
The financial ranges specified in the announcement are adjusted and may differ from the range specified in the remuneration regulations.
We are looking for you if:
You understand and applySite Reliability Engineering principles: automation-first, reducing toil, and reliability as a feature.
You have experience indesigning and operating highly available, scalable systems.
You have hands-on experience withcontainerization(Kubernetes/OpenShift) andobservabilitytools.
You bring deep expertise inLinux/Unix, Tomcat, networking, and RDBMS (Oracle/MSSQL).
You have strong proficiency inWindows systems administration, especially with ASP.NET/.NET Core apps on IIS.
You can define and work withSLIs, SLOs, and SLAsto improve system reliability.
You have strong skills inmonitoring, observability, and incident management.
You can script or code inPowerShelland bring and familiarity withCI/CD pipelines(Azure DevOps or similar).
You collaborate effectively and promote aculture of reliabilityacross teams.
You'll get extra points for
Experience with Agile platforms and rapid scaling.
Familiarity withELK stack, Prometheus + Grafana, and enterprise scheduling tools (TWSd, UAC).
Scripting inPython, automation withAnsible, and infrastructure as code (Terraform/Pulumi).
Applying DevOps/SRE practices to front-office banking processes.
DemonstratingAgile Ways of Workingand staying ahead of tech trends.
Ability to leadblameless postmortemsand drive continuous improvement.
Understanding ofdistributed systems and microservices architecture.
Your responsibilities
Monitor & troubleshootproduction systems, proactively resolving issues and improving reliability.
Lead and mentora growing team across multiple locations.
Drive observability, incident/problem management, and root cause analysis.
Plan capacityand assess system health to ensure optimal performance.
Manage SLAs, holding teams accountable for service quality.
Ensure IT control compliance, supporting audits with evidence.
Automate operationsusing bots and runners to streamline infrastructure tasks.
Coordinate disaster recoveryand business continuity planning.
Generate production reportson availability, reliability, and performance.
Occasionally respond tobusiness service requests, such as backup restores.
Advocate forSRE best practicesand contribute to a culture of reliability and continuous improvement.
Information about the squad:
You will join the ESG Product Area within ING’s Wholesale Banking Sustainability Tribe. Our mission is to integrate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) principles into all aspects of our business and help clients transition toward sustainable practices. The team is dynamic, collaborative, and focused on delivering cutting-edge solutions for measuring and managing emissions, client transition plans, ESG-related data, and business intelligence. Together, we aim to maintain ING’s leadership in financing sustainable transitions.
